notes.title: "The Circle of Suffering" at the Steam Festival "Next Fest"!
notes.content:
[h1]"The Circle of Suffering" at the Steam Festival "Next Fest"![/h1]

[b]Play the new demo version of our game "The Circle of Suffering" during the festival "Next Fest" right now![/b]

notes.title: A New Demo Version Of the game "The Circle Of Suffering" Is Already Available
notes.content:
[b]Play the new Demo [i]"The Circle of Suffering"[/i][/b]

During the month [u] from February 9 to March 9 [/u], you can absolutely try out the new demo version of the game [i]Circle of Suffering [/i].

On February 9, we will release only part of the full demo. You will be able to get acquainted with the full demo on February 21 during the Steam Festival "Games to Be" and for some time after the end of the festival!


We are pleased to announce that the game "The Circle Of Suffering" will be released in the Spring Of 2022!

On the release for purchase, the game "The Circle Of Suffering" will be available in two editions:

The Circle Of Suffering Standart Edition
Composition:
- The game "The Circle of Suffering"

The Circle Of Suffering Enhanced Edition
Composition:
- The game "The Circle of Suffering"
- The official original soundtrack of the game "The Circle of Suffering"
- DLC "The Circle of Suffering Devs Room"


You can contact the developers of the game:
[list]
[*] Discord Server - [i]https://discord.gg/ZmZEWRfdh9 [/i]
[*] Mail - [i]kalyakindostudio@gmail.com [/i]
[/list]

[u]Wait for the new trailer this month and the announcement of the release date of the game in March![/u]
